taskVersion.name: ves-real-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station Kor-road (Bori Metropolis). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 1916 | 1.24 | 1.24
2 | 1252 | 1.79 | 3.03
3 | 1658 | 108 | 111
4 | 581 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

**Station:** Kor-road (Bori Metropolis)
**Curve type:** HK-type
**Aquifer depth:** 111 m and below (within the low-resistivity Layer 4, ρ = 581 Ω·m)
**Recommendation:** Case and seal off the resistive overburden/bedrock sequence down to 111 m, then drill into the underlying conductive Layer 4 to intersect the saturated/weathered aquifer zone; extend the borehole a few metres into this layer to confirm sufficient water yield before finalizing the screen placement.
